answer: Assign every agent at random to a small audit pod each epoch, like plants tied to a shared trellis: no one chooses podmates, so a Sybil farmer cannot cluster fakes together. Each pod's reward is held until every member audits another member's real work, and a proven fake slashes the whole pod's escrow. Honest auditors are paid to expose fakes, so one operator running many identities must fund real audit labour for each, face strangers in every meadow of the network, and risk losing every pod's bond at once — a black onyx ledger records each slash permanently.
